title: interview-live: reactive TUI dashboard (participant count, live transcript, prioritized question/topic queue)
description: Turn interview-live's plain stdout loop into a reactive curses dashboard. At session start the user marks how many participants are in the conversation (count only; whisper -di stays capped at 2 speaker labels, guests share speaker 1). The TUI then shows: (a) the live rolling transcript, and (b) a prioritized queue of pi-suggested follow-up questions plus important topics, ordered so recurring/high-priority items float to the top as the interview progresses. Observe-only default: no interaction required; minimal optional keys (q quit, space mark top question asked, PgUp/PgDn scroll). TUI auto-enables on a TTY (--no-tui to force plain mode; --tui to force). Worker side: pi system prompt extended to ask for JSON {questions, topics[high|med|low]} with a tolerant fallback to legacy plain lines; new queue.json artifact (dedupe + mention counts + scores); --participants N flag feeds roster display and the pi system prompt.
design:
- tests/test_interview_live.py: PI_FAKE gains PI_MODE=json branch; new e2e tests for participants + queue.json; unit tests (in-file, importing bin/interview_live_core) for recurrence ranking and parsing fallback
- new bin/interview_live_core.py: pure Queue model (normalize/ingest/rank/snapshot) + parse_suggestion_output (JSON first, plain-line fallback); no I/O, no curses
- new bin/interview_live_tui.py: TuiState, pure build_layout() (curses-free, unit-testable), thin curses draw()/prompt_participants()/run_dashboard(); lazy curses import so plain mode never depends on ncurses
- bin/interview-live: imports core+tui (sys.path insert of script dir, symlink-safe); suggest() parses pi output into Queue, writes queue.json + questions.md (questions and topics sections); run()/run_loop refactored: worker loop appends to TuiState when ui active (no stdout writes), plain loop unchanged; _run_tui = worker thread + curses.wrapper; SIGINT handler keeps plain-mode behavior
acceptance_criteria: - new tests pass: participants forwarded to pi system prompt (3 / default 2); queue.json written with deduped topics gaining mentions across rounds and high scores ranking above low; plain pi output still lands in questions.md and works (fallback); participants 0 rejected at CLI; --no-tui/pipe mode keeps existing 9 tests green (plain stdout)
notes: Implemented + validated in session. 30 interview-live tests pass (9 original + 5 new e2e + 4 unit in test_interview_live.py; 12 in test_interview_live_tui.py); full suite 98 passed, 12 errors are pre-existing test_terapia fixture issues (canticos-0cd). Real-pty TUI smoke passed: participants prompt (3), Guests(2) roles, priority queue pane, q quits cleanly. Code NOT committed yet (conservative beads profile).
